entries.title: Copying the app's own record no longer leads to a crash
entries.body: When a crewmate copied the app's own record files from one of your computers, the app on that computer could later crash while reading its record. A copy now leaves the running app's hold on its record in place, so the app keeps working through it.
entries.noPicture: The fix is the app no longer crashing some time after such a copy; nothing on screen changes.
